papers.title: Defects in parts manufactured by selective laser melting caused by δ-ferrite in reused 316L steel powder feedstock
papers.first_author_affiliation: Lorena School of Engineering, University of Sao Paulo, 12602-810, Lorena, SP, Brazil

corresponding_authors.name: H.R.Z. Sandim
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Lorena School of Engineering, University of Sao Paulo, 12602-810, Lorena, SP, Brazil

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文关注增材制造中粉末再利用导致的缺陷，与生物医用植入物的力学性能或骨整合无直接关联。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structure design, stress shielding, fatigue testing, or osseointegration; it focuses on powder reuse and defect formation in 316L steel, not biomedical implant performance.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究再利用316L钢粉中δ-铁素体对SLM成型缺陷的影响。
summary_zh.method: 分析不同循环次数粉末的微观结构和缺陷特征。
summary_zh.result: 发现δ-铁素体导致内部缺陷和力学性能下降。
summary_zh.validation: 通过显微观察和力学测试验证缺陷存在。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate how δ-ferrite in reused 316L steel powder feedstock induces defects in selective laser melted parts.
summary_en.method: Microstructural characterization and defect analysis of powders and as-built specimens with varying reuse cycles.
summary_en.result: δ-ferrite content increases with reuse, leading to porosity and reduced mechanical properties.
summary_en.validation: Validation via optical microscopy, SEM, and tensile testing of manufactured samples.
